topics.title: Appendix D — Production Readiness Review
topics.summary: A heterogeneous component is ready for a release decision when the source and build are reproducible; dependencies are controlled; reference behavior is tested; supported GPU paths are tested on named hardware; numerical tolerances are justified; performance measurements use defined scopes; resource ownership is explicit; queueing is bounded; errors remain observable; and startup, shutdown, and failure recovery have tests.

blocks.text: A heterogeneous component is ready for a release decision when the source and build are reproducible; dependencies are controlled; reference behavior is tested; supported GPU paths are tested on named hardware; numerical tolerances are justified; performance measurements use defined scopes; resource ownership is explicit; queueing is bounded; errors remain observable; and startup, shutdown, and failure recovery have tests.
rich: A heterogeneous component is ready for a release decision when the source and build are reproducible; dependencies are controlled; reference behavior is tested; supported GPU paths are tested on named hardware; numerical tolerances are justified; performance measurements use defined scopes; resource ownership is explicit; queueing is bounded; errors remain observable; and startup, shutdown, and failure recovery have tests.

blocks.text: The review must also list what was not verified. Multi-GPU execution, particular compute capabilities, driver versions, hard-real-time scheduling, or vendor-library configurations should never be implied by tests performed elsewhere. A precise limitation increases the usefulness of evidence because future engineers know which questions remain open.
